instruction.text: Select the two sentences that contain a preposition.

b: ++Omar wrote a story after school last week.
++Omar’s father gave him some advice before he wrote his story.
Omar spent four hours writing his story.
Sean spent many hours designing his table.
++Sean’s table will go in his kitchen.
Sean will throw away his old table.
++Ruby has a hockey match after school.
++Ruby has played hockey since she was 5.
Ruby spends a lot of time playing hockey.
++John studies between school and football practice.
John’s parents like his hard work.
Chiara thinks bookshops are very peaceful.
++Chiara normally goes to bookshops by herself.
Felicity rides her bike very often.
++Felicity is going to cycle into town.
Gemma enjoys playing cricket a lot.
++Gemma asked for a new cricket bat.
Gemma is a very good batter.
Gemma likes her local cricket club.
